summary: Rising Dragon Acquisition Corp., a blank-check company, filed an 8-K reporting issuance of unsecured promissory notes totaling approximately $111,274 (two notes of $27,818.50 and one of $55,637.41) to its sponsor and a merger counterparty designee to fund a trust-account extension to August 15, 2026. Notes bear no interest, mature at business combination close, and are convertible into units at $10.00. No special situation; this is routine SPAC extension financing.
